name: Press Depth Button
description: A button with physical depth: a 2px base edge the face sinks into on press, four variants, three sizes. Loading and success swap the label in place, so width stays fixed.
usage:
import { PressDepthButton } from "@/components/design-for-ai/button-press-depth";

<PressDepthButton label="Save changes" onPress={() => api.save()} />  // returns a promise: spinner, then check, in the same box

<PressDepthButton label="Publish" loadingLabel="Publishing…" successLabel="Live" errorLabel="Didn’t publish" onPress={() => api.publish()} />

<PressDepthButton variant="secondary" size="sm" label="Preview" icon />  // no promise returned: stays idle, no spinner or check

<PressDepthButton variant="destructive" label="Delete project" leadingIcon={<TrashIcon />} trailingIcon={null} />

<PressDepthButton state="loading" label="Publish" loadingLabel="Publishing…" />  // controlled: you drive the state

props.name: label
props.description: Resting label. The loading and success glyphs replace it in the same box, so the width never changes.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Optional text beside the spinner while onPress is pending. Without it the spinner replaces the label in the same box.

props.name: successLabel
props.description: Optional text beside the check once onPress settles. Without it the check replaces the label in the same box.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: Announced through the status region when a returned promise rejects. The button then returns to idle.

props.name: variant
props.description: Primary takes the accent fill. Secondary is a raised neutral. Ghost has no edge and no fill at rest. Destructive is the one red.

props.name: size
props.description: 32, 40 or 48px tall; sm and md expand their hit area to 44px.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Leave it out and a returned promise from onPress drives loading and success itself.

props.name: icon
props.description: Shows the built-in arrow after the label.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Any glyph before the label. Drawn at the size's icon width by you.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Any glyph after the label. Overrides icon; pass null to hide it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent. It fills the primary button; its base edge and label colour are derived from it.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the button sits on, so its neutrals keep their contrast. Typed as PressDepthTheme.

props.name: successMs
props.description: Uncontrolled only: how long the success state holds before it returns to idle.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Runs on press. Only a returned promise shows loading, then success; a rejected promise returns to idle and announces errorLabel. A plain or synchronous return leaves the button idle.

props.name: className
props.description: Applied to the outer wrapper, not the button.
